inlines.v: DISTINCTNESS, noun 1. The quality or state of being distinct; a separation or difference that prevents confusion of parts or things; as the distinctness of two ideas, or of distant objects. 2. Nice discrimination; whence, clearness; precision; as, he stated his arguments with great distinctness
